Wait Time: Hands down; let him think
Turn-and-Talk: How many cans of grape juice?

Turn-and-Talk: Can everyone turn and repeat that idea?
Revoicing: So you're saying I can't buy one can...?
Revoicing: So you multiplied the length...?
Say More: Can you tell me what you did?
Say More: Tell me a little bit more
Who Can Repeat? He's not all done yet
Who Can Repeat? She was counting by fives
Who Can Repeat? Finding the volume of a rectangular prism
Who Can Repeat? How did you know that seven-eighths was greater than three-fourths?
Who Can Repeat? Which table is 'the root beer drinkers?'
Press for Reasoning: Are you sure? How do you know?
Press for Reasoning: Can you prove it?
Press for Reasoning: Why does that work?
Do You Agree or Disagree... and Why? Why do you agree with him?
Do You Agree or Disagree... and Why? Do almost all of the people do their homework before dinner?
Do You Agree or Disagree... and Why? Not to be rude but...
Who Can Add On? Would you like to add on to the beginning of her thinking?
Who Can Add On? Who can add on to that?
